records.text: And Elisha said to him, “Go, say to him, ‘You will certainly recover’[a]; but Yahweh has shown me that he will certainly die.”

new_note.text: POB follows the Hebrew reading tradition (qere), which has לו, ‘to him,’ followed by the positive recovery message. The written form (ketiv) has לא, ‘not,’ making that message negative. These readings affect how Hazael's report in verse 14 relates to Elisha's instruction; their historical priority remains uncertain.
